inputs.question: What does a buffer do between two machines in a production line?

output: A buffer stores and regulates the flow of products between two machines in a production line.

inputs.documents:
[01_line_overview]
Line A - overview

Line A produces aluminium pump housings. It runs an Early and a Late shift on weekdays and adds a Night shift when demand is high.

Parts flow through six stations in this order. Press P1 feeds buffer B1, which feeds Press P2. Press P2 feeds buffer B2, which feeds Washer W1. Washer W1 feeds buffer B3, which feeds Assembly cell A1. Assembly cell A1 feeds buffer B4, which feeds Inspection station I1. Inspection station I1 feeds buffer B5, which feeds Packer K1.

Packer K1 is the last station of Line A; packed boxes go straight to the shipping area.

[03_datasheet_P2]
Machine data sheet - Press P2

Type: hydraulic deep-drawing press (Press)
Installed on: Line A
Cycle time: 48 s per part
Rated power: 90 kW
MTBF: 140 h
MTTR: 4 h

Notes: 630 t press with a main cylinder that was resealed in 2024.

[08_buffer_layout]
Buffer layout, Line A (updated February 2026)

Buffer B1 sits between Press P1 and Press P2. It is a roller conveyor with a capacity of 40 parts.
Buffer B2 sits between Press P2 and Washer W1, capacity 30 parts.
Buffer B3 sits between Washer W1 and Assembly cell A1, capacity 25 parts.
Buffer B4 sits between Assembly cell A1 and Inspection station I1, capacity 20 parts.
Buffer B5 sits between Inspection station I1 and Packer K1, capacity 15 parts.

[20_energy_audit]
Energy audit note, Line A, March 2026 (external auditor)

Rated power of the main consumers on Line A: Press P2 90 kW, Press P1 75 kW, Washer W1 45 kW (of which 30 kW is tank heating), Assembly cell A1 18 kW, Packer K1 12 kW, Inspection station I1 6 kW.
The two presses account for most of the electrical demand of the line.
Compressed-air leaks are estimated at an extra 8 kW equivalent.
Recommendation: heat recovery on the washer and a leak-detection round every quarter.

[21_safety_walk]
Safety walk, 10 March 2026

Fire extinguisher next to Press P2 checked (pressure 15 bar, OK).
Emergency stop at Washer W1 tested, OK.
Floor marking next to buffer B3 is worn and must be repainted.
Two near-miss reports were filed this quarter, none on Line A.
